rows.title: Volunteer Income Tax Assistance Training
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge and ability in preparing income tax returns, through analysis and preparation of financial documents.
Interpret and analyze financial information for internal controls and re-evaluation of returns.
Demonstrate high ethical and legal standards by recognizing and preventing inaccurate entries of false information gathering when interviewing clients.

rows.title: Arabic 1
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Demonstrate reading and listening comprehension of basic everyday materials related to oneself, family and immediate surroundings within a cultural context. These may include, but are not limited to, advertisements, time tables, short personal letters, dialogues, readings, conversations, and video and audio recordings.

Communicate, both orally and in writing, about familiar topics and activities requiring a simple and direct exchange of information within a cultural context. This communication may include, but is not limited to, simple verbal and written exchanges such as dialogues and paragraphs related to oneself, family and immediate surroundings.

Reflect on and evaluate similarities and differences in specific cultural practices and perspectives as related, but not limited to, greetings, education, family traditions, sports, leisure activities, cultural events and artistic expressions.

rows.title: Hybrid and Electric Vehicle Technology 1
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Demonstrate personal and shop safety procedures needed to safely work with high voltage systems.
Demonstrate knowledge of hybrid and electric vehicle component operation.
Describe basic maintenance procedures related to hybrid and electric vehicles.
Identify proper diagnostic and repair procedures as the relate to basic hybrid or electric vehicle faults.

rows.title: Computer Architecture and Organization: Assembly
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Analyze and interpret assembly language code and hexadecimal format. Demonstrate how fundamental high-level programming constructs are implemented at the machine-language level.
Write and execute programs in assembly language (utilizing application programming interfaces) illustrating typical mathematic and business applications.

rows.title: Fundamentals of Baking I
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Define basic ingredients and formulas in preparing baking products.
Apply skills in correcting baking failures, develop recognition of high-quality baked products and evaluate errors made in baking mixtures and products.
Develop manipulative skills necessary for employment in bake shops, school cafeterias, convalescent hospitals, community feeding programs, and commercial foods services.

rows.title: DC Electronics
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Solve basic, direct current, electronic problems involving resistance, current, voltage, and power, as applied to both simple and complex combinations of series and/or parallel circuit components, comprised of resistors, capacitors and coils, in a given network configuration.
Diagram and discuss the relationship between electricity and magnetism as related to a DC permanent magnet motor, a solenoid or an electromechanical relay.
Describe and contrast the construction, operation, and purpose of resistors, potentiometers, switches, fuses, relays, and batteries.

rows.title: California Mechanical Codes
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Cite code sections and apply provisions with relation to mechanical codes in construction, regulation and design.
Interpret and apply appropriate knowledge of combustion and air circulation in a gas systems as per mechanical code.

rows.title: Physical Geography
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Identify and explain basic facts, rules, principles, and mechanisms of the atmosphere, lithosphere, hydrosphere, and biosphere and how spheres interact with each other to explain spatial issues.
Assess the impact of location on the elements of air, water, land, and the biosphere.
Communicate geographic and scientific information, including multiple perspectives on physical processes.
Utilize geographic tools such as maps, graphs, data, and images to think critically about and solve spatial issues.

rows.title: World Religions
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Explain the relationship between the cultural phenomenon of religion and the development of the category "religion" as variously defined in religious studies.
Compare and evaluate how religious traditions develop in particular contexts and cultures using the methods and tools presented in the course.
Demonstrate the ability to interpret primary and secondary sources and to know what role each plays in the development of an argument that uses them for support.

rows.title: Manufacturing Basic Operations
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Describe an employer's PPE responsibilities.
Describe how to interpret a third angle projection multiview drawing.
Define electrical power and give its units of measurement
Describe how to run a robot program.
Explain the advantages and disadvantages of electronic sensors.

rows.title: Medical Terminology for Healthcare Professionals
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Understand and apply medical terms used by a variety of healthcare professionals in the provision of quality, safe, patient-centered care.
Participate in collaborative relationships through the understanding and application of a common language used by healthcare professionals in a variety of settings.
Incorporate critical thinking principles into apply the use of medical terms in various healthcare scenarios.

rows.title: Commercial and Advertising Photography
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Photograph images that demonstrate an advanced understanding of composition and design.
Exercise observation skills and judgement to create professional quality photographs.
Demonstrate an advanced understanding of how to use Adobe Lightroom and Adobe Photoshop to post-process photographs.
